source.title: Verify Grindr chat oldest-history boundary before acquisition verdict
source.objective: Resolve conflicting Grindr chat acquisition verdicts by verifying the true oldest available history boundary and defining reliable PASS/FAIL evidence when the textual start marker is absent. Preserve the 65-child capture and do not assume temporary scroll stability proves completion.
